source_title: Up or down? Short-term reversal, momentum, and liquidity effects in cryptocurrency markets
hypothesis: Within the less-liquid portion of the point-in-time Binance perpetual universe, recent losers outperform recent winners over the next day.
mechanism: Short-horizon price pressure and illiquidity-driven overreaction reverse; the source reports that daily reversal is concentrated in less-liquid cryptocurrencies.
signal: Negative lagged close-to-close return over the previous 24 hours; neighboring preregistered lookbacks 12 and 48 hours.
universe: Point-in-time assets with 30 days of exact hourly continuity; retain bottom 60 percent by lagged trailing 30-day mean close*volume; minimum 8 assets.
rebalance: Daily at 00:00 UTC. Signal uses only bars completed before execution; trade at current 00:00 open.
construction: Equal-weight long highest reversal-signal tercile / short lowest reversal-signal tercile, 0.5 gross per side.
development_gate: canonical mean rank IC >= 0.02, HAC p < 0.05, positive long-minus-short next-day return
limitations: Available panel contains 19 curated liquid Binance perpetuals, not the thousands of coins in the source; bottom-60-percent liquidity is relative within this panel and survivorship bias remains possible.
